title: Smarter Keys, Better Performance: Exploring Business Central v29 Index Updates
summary: Business Central v29 allows administrators to manage indexes and SIFT keys directly through the Index Management page rather than only through AL code, enabled by a new unified table structure. This lets teams adjust or retire indexes as performance needs change without requiring development work.
key_points: The unified table structure in v29 removes previous restrictions on non-AL based index management that existed because native and extension fields were stored separately.
Administrators can now activate, deactivate, or modify indexes and SIFT keys from the Index Management page for the entire system or individual companies.
Keys can now span both native fields and extension fields in the same index, which was previously impossible and caused errors in v28 and earlier.
Over time, indexes that were initially beneficial may become unnecessary and degrade performance, so this feature allows teams to manage them without waiting for development support.

quotes.text: With the new unified table structure in v29, those restrictions are gone. You can now manage SIFT indexes directly from the Index Management page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability change that enables administrators to control indexes without AL code.

quotes.text: BC V29 quietly delivers one of the most meaningful performance-tuning upgrades in a long time.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the significance of this release feature for system performance optimization.
